Some key points about his lines:
✏ Pink lines are placeholders for responses!
✏ Responding to him? Red lines are pending responses from you!
✏ Certain lines will have NOTES giving context on events that happened in non-English Puyo/Madou games. This is more likely to show up on spinoffs and otherwise more obscure parts of the series.

TARGETS OF INTEREST
🐘 Schezo is terrible at catching himself when it comes to his poor phrasing. If the marker has "sus" in it, there's your chance to react to his vocab.
⚔️ But when he's not scuffing his vocab, he plays the straight man to everyone else's antics. That doesn't mean he's devoid of quirks, of course.
⚔️ He's one of the more anti-heroic characters from Puyo Puyo's cast. He has honor and morals, but is pretty selfish about his ambitions.
⚔️ Tries to keep his cool. Keyword being tries. Default attitude is stoic snark, but calling him a 'creeper' or 'pervert' is the easiest way to piss him off. Getting frisky with his comfort zone can make him lose nerve.
⚔️ His knowledge on sexual topics is rather shallow, making the assumption he is a pervert ironic in itself.
⚔️ And from the combination of "keep cool until he doesn't" and surface-level sexual knowledge, he can barely handle flirtation.
⚔️ Relationship to Arle is pretty complicated.
⚔️ Schezo is a dark mage. Doesn't sound like the most friendly title. Additionally, he doesn't look like a typical mage.
⚔️ Yes, his sword is translucent. If you ask, he might tell more...
⚔️ Magic and other supernatural powers grabs his attention.
⚔️ He can be a bit rough around the edges when trying to show his kinder side, but he means what he says. Has a weird way of telling shy and self-deprecating people they're better than they think they are.
⚔️ Cute things! He likes cute animal creatures and will (briefly) gush about them.

pendingLines.line: (Player named Arle) I don't believe you're Arle. Your clothes aren't blue, for one, and you don't have Carbuncle.
...I'm not buying that. For all I know, you could be a doppelganger.
That trickery isn't fooling me. Who do you take me for?
...Really? Trying to impersonate Arle when she's right there?
(xmas) Admittedly, that costume was rather cozy and warm...
(Barnaby cosplay) If you must know, these glasses aren't true glasses. They're just metal frames with false lenses.
We're in a strip poker game, Arle. Just give me this one, alright?
Arle!! Of all the times you call me that, it's in the least uncalled for situation!
Ah, ahem... ~succubus~, could I ask a rather strange favor?
Do...you...have a whip? There's something I need to confirm for myself, and I need you to strike me with it.
(...Why did that feel good?! Do I actually...!?)
Possession, huh? I've had prior experience with that, too.
(to Cynthia) It's a difficult read, but I could lend you a book about Rana the Fallen Imperial Capital. Has a fascinating history that made me aspire to surpass the legends.
(Double-edged ref) Both? I can wield my sword with either hand, but wielding two swords is a different matter altogether.
Both? Can't say for certain as I don't swing the Dark Sword too often. Concerned about the durability of its crystalline blade.
Both? Truth be told, I lack formal training. My swordplay is more or less self-taught.
Not to mention a previous incident I had with a sword turned out to be a venture that vastly outweighed the boons I would have obtained.
To keep it short, the second sword managed to get in my head, and what would have been dual sword fighting, turned into swords fighting.

(on school) I was something of a class misfit. Skipped lectures, picked fights with gangs... yet in spite of it, I took my magic studies seriously, comprehending ancient grimoires with little struggle.
I'm rather surprised I managed to avoid expulsion and make it to graduation.
(to Arle) I just passed by here by mere chance. I wasn't actively looking for it.
But I don't. I have my priorities straight!
(to Ringo) HEY! I only passed here by mere circumstance!
That was a slip of the tongue. I've improved on my phrasing since then!
(+Arle) Arle can attest to that!
(relationship with Arle) I am acquainted with Arle, but I don't see her that way!
What- NO! I don't like her! Well...not in that way.
Yes, we do bicker constantly but... I would be lying if I said I dislike her.
It's rather complicated, but as much as Arle and I squabble...I don't hold any animosity against her.
Yes, I still do want her power, but at the same time... Her presence brings much entertainment to the recluse life I live.
I still do want her power... but I don't think I have it in me to take her life if it comes to that.
Ah, ahem. Don't mind me. (Why did I say that last part? It isn't like me to be sentimental...)
(Satan on table) (Oh confound it, he's here?)
(Satan on table w/ Arle) (Oh confound it, of course he's here.)
(to Satan) Oh great, look who decided to show himself. And no, she's not here, obviously.
(to Satan w/ Arle) Oh great, look who decided to ruin this game.
(to not his Satan) Oh great, look who...wait, you're not him.
(Schezo's Scar A) With how we are nowadays, it's hard to believe you inflicted this mark on me.
I know, I know... Still a work-in-progress.
(Schezo's Scar B) That was a time ago, in hindsight. Yet we have this rather odd dynamic.
Fate works in strange ways. Attempt to defy fate, you get led to another.

(Midsummer Aloha) Aloha!
A shining sun without someone's meddling. As it should be!
With weather like this, I can't help but get a craving for starfruit.
I kinda regret not bringing my ukulele for this occasion. Not that I know how to play one well.
Sandals aren't that different from walking barefoot to me, so I'll part with these first.
Wait, did I just... Well it's better than getting sunburned under a gigantic sun.
Wait, tanlines...!? Am I really that vulnerable to the sun!?
At least I can enjoy the sand.
Went to an amusement park, huh? Reminds me of my no-good terrible day at one.
I had lost my power prior to going to this specific amusement park, as I had the feeling the prize was something I've encountered previously.
I had lost my power prior to going to this specific amusement park, but I was racing to get this magical artifact before Arle and Rulue... oh...I never did tell you my side of the story, did I...?
